Signed release of the Mahuva Kshatriya Rajput Samaj community directory.

- **mvpmi.apk** — install on Android phones (Android 5.0 or newer). Share the link from the community website.
- **mvpmi-play.aab** — upload this file in Google Play Console (Production → Create new release).
- **SHA256SUMS.txt** — checksums to verify the downloads.

Each release installs over the previous one; members stay signed in.
